question:
The engineer must configure SPAN on a Cisco Nexus 5000 Series Switch to get a capture of the traffic from these applications for an in-depth packet analysis.
Which two SPAN characteristics must be considered? (Choose two.)
options: SPAN source ports can be monitored in multiple SPAN sessions.
The Ethernet, FC, vFC, port channel, SAN port channel can be used as SPAN source ports.
A SPAN source port cannot be a destination SPAN port.
Only Ethernet, FC, vFC, port channel port types can be used as SPAN source ports.
The rx/tx option is available for VLAN or VSAN SPAN sessions.
